name: Y Combinator
stage: Idea-stage: yes (no product, no revenue, no incorporation needed to apply; YC FAQ: about 40% of funded companies are 'just an idea'). Solo founders accepted.
check_size_terms: $500,000 total: $125,000 post-money SAFE for 7% + $375,000 uncapped MFN SAFE; pro rata rights; no fees
sectors: Sector-agnostic (heavy AI/software weighting in recent batches)
geography: Global applicants; program is in-person in San Francisco (3-day kickoff + weekly SF meetups). No remote/online batch option is offered as of 2026-09-02.
application_timing: batch; Winter 2027 on-time deadline 2026-11-02 8pm PT (decision by 2026-12-11); Early Decision open for Spring/Summer/Fall batches; four batches per year
notes: Accepts idea-stage and unincorporated teams; ~40% of each batch is idea-only. Batch is in-person in SF; the remote-batch era (2020-2021) is over. Late applications are still reviewed but on-time gives a decision by a fixed date.

name: Antler
stage: Idea-stage: yes (pre-team, pre-idea accepted; residency is designed to match co-founders and build from 'Day Zero'). Antler Elevate handles Series A+ separately.
check_size_terms: Varies by location. Antler Disrupt Deal (2026-01-05): $400K = $250K for 10% via SAFE + $150K uncapped MFN SAFE. Singapore/Japan 2026: $150K for 10% ($100K for 10% + $50K uncapped MFN SAFE) + up to $250K matching. Antler India AI Residency: INR 4Cr (~$470K) for 11% + up to $30M follow-on.
geography: Global: 26 locations across APAC (incl. India/Bangalore), Europe, Americas, Middle East/Africa. Residencies are in-person per city.
application_timing: rolling by location; residencies/sprints run throughout the year. Antler India: 'Next Residency will be announced soon' (no date on 2026-09-02).
notes: Backs individuals before a company exists and helps form teams during the residency. Deal terms differ by country; check the local residency page. Antler India (X: @AntlerIndia) runs a Bangalore AI Residency: 3-week decision, INR 4Cr for 11%, INR 2L relocation grant, in-person first 2 weeks.

name: Entrepreneur First (EF)
stage: Idea-stage: yes (pre-team, pre-idea, pre-company; individuals are assessed 'before they have a business, cofounder or an idea').
check_size_terms: Equity-free grant during ideation; up to $250K investment once a company is formed (equity % not stated on site); up to $5M follow-on through future rounds; $600K+ credits; 9 months office space
sectors: Sector-agnostic; deep tech and AI focus
geography: London, Bangalore, San Francisco (in-person). Visa help possible for other locations.
application_timing: batch; Bangalore programme early deadline 2026-10-05 (start Feb 2027); London programme start Apr 2027; SF 'Bridge Residency' start Feb 2027; XF2 London start Fall 2026
notes: Talent investor: no cofounder or idea needed to apply. Pays a grant while you find a cofounder and idea, then invests when you incorporate. Contact via form at joinef.com/contact/ only.

name: Pioneer (pioneer.app)
stage: Idea-stage: yes historically (online tournament for side projects and early ideas), but the program is CLOSED: 'We stopped making new investments in 2024'.
check_size_terms: unknown (program closed to new investments since 2024)
geography: Global, fully online (historical: 300+ founders in 50+ countries)
notes: Founded 2018 by Daniel Gross and Rishi Narang; backed by Stripe and Marc Andreessen. Official site states it stopped making new investments in 2024. Do not spend outreach effort here; listed for completeness.

name: Z Fellows
stage: Idea-stage: yes (side projects, no company needed: 'No. We can help you set up one.'; 'no such thing as too early').
check_size_terms: $10,000 investment at a $1B valuation cap (converts at next priced round); participation without investment also possible
geography: Global ('You can be based anywhere'); mostly virtual, last day in-person in SF or NYC
application_timing: rolling; no deadline; multiple 1-week cohorts per year
notes: 1-week program with ten builders and founders of $1B+ companies. Founder Cory Levy reviews applications personally and posts about it on X. Prior rejections may reapply.

name: Neo (Neo Residency, formerly Neo Accelerator)
stage: Idea-stage: yes (targets very early startups and 'high-agency student teams'; students get grants before a company exists).
check_size_terms: Neo Residency (announced Feb 2026): $750K uncapped SAFE + $450K+ compute credits; Neo gets participation rights up to 5% in next equity round. Student teams: $40K grant per person + $100K+ credits. Profit share in Neo fund for every founder/student.
sectors: Sector-agnostic; strong AI focus (Microsoft and OpenAI mentorship for AI companies)
geography: US-based program: 3 months SF workspace + 2-week Oregon bootcamp; global applicants
application_timing: rolling ('applications are open... rolling basis'); no fixed deadline found on 2026-09-02
notes: Neo Residency replaced Neo Accelerator in Feb 2026; small cohorts (12-15 startups, 5-8 student teams). Neo was Cursor's first investor. Neo.com is JS-rendered; terms above come from Neo's official Substack.

name: South Park Commons (SPC Founder Fellowship)
stage: Idea-stage: yes (no finalized idea required: 'No, but you do need to show us how you generate ideas').
check_size_terms: $400K upfront for 7% on a standard SAFE + $600K guaranteed in next external round ($1M total); up to $1M in credits
geography: San Francisco, New York City, Bangalore (8-week in-person bootcamp, then residency)
application_timing: batch; two cohorts per year. Fall 2026 deadline was 2026-08-02 (closed). Spring 2026 deadline was 2026-02-01; Spring 2027 deadline not yet announced on 2026-09-02.
notes: Fellowship for founders in the '-1 to 0' phase; 8-week bootcamp then open-ended residency. Official site footer links x.com/spc; older posts appear under @southpkcommons. Member Residency is a separate track for technologists who may not want to start a company yet.

name: Techstars
stage: Idea-stage: partial. Pre-revenue accepted but evidence of progress expected; many admitted teams already raised $1M-$5M. The Founder Catalyst pre-accelerator targets idea-stage founders.
check_size_terms: $220,000: $200,000 uncapped MFN SAFE + $20,000 CEA for 5% common stock (APAC programs: $100,000 MFN SAFE + $20K CEA)
sectors: Sector-agnostic; many vertical programs (healthcare, AI health, workforce, etc.)
geography: Global: Boston, Boulder, Chicago, London, NYC, Tokyo, Los Angeles and others; 'Techstars Anywhere' is remote-first
application_timing: batch; Spring 2027 applications opened 2026-08-24, NYC final deadline 2026-11-18 (program starts 2027-03-08). Deadlines vary by program.
notes: 3-month mentorship-driven program; terms mirror YC structure since April 2025. Best fit for teams with some traction; pure idea-stage founders should look at Techstars Founder Catalyst. Only address found on site is privacy@techstars.com (not for applications).

name: Pear VC (PearX)
stage: Idea-stage: yes ('Any founder starting a company is eligible'; most teams have not raised before; solo founders accepted).
check_size_terms: $500K to $2M per company, terms negotiated per company ('we'll work with you')
sectors: Sector-agnostic; AI, enterprise, biotech, consumer verticals with partner expertise
geography: In-person in San Francisco Bay Area (Pear Studio SF and Menlo Park); 12-week program; global applicants must relocate
application_timing: batch; PearX W27 regular deadline 2026-10-04; two cohorts per year (Winter Jan-Apr, Summer Jul-Oct); funds year-round
notes: Small cohorts (~20-25 teams); all partners are former founders or operators. Starts working with teams before the cohort begins. Contact only via form at pear.vc/contact-us.

name: HF0
stage: Idea-stage: yes, but only for REPEAT founders ('The residency for repeat founders'). First-time founders are not the target.
check_size_terms: unknown on official site; secondary sources (2025-2026) report $1M uncapped SAFE for 5%
geography: San Francisco, live-in 12-week residency (secondary sources); 10 teams per batch
application_timing: batch; site lists 'Batch Starts: September 13' and 'Batch Starts: January 4' with Demo Days 'December 4' / 'Dec 1'; no application deadline posted on 2026-09-02
notes: 'Startup monastery' model: housing, meals, no distractions, 10 teams at a time. Dave Fontenot invites repeat unicorn founders to DM him on X. Official site publishes batch dates and outcome facts but not deal terms.
